scripts.build: npm run art:manifest && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp index.html dist/index.html 2>/dev/null || true; find dist -name '.render-state.json' -delete; echo 'build complete'
scripts.check: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:scene && npm run test:clinical && npm run test:speech && npm run test:journal && npm run test:words-voice && npm run test:voice-pack && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:voice && node test-routines.js
